temporary_binary_namespace.reason: Runtime binary, datadir, config-file, and artifact-name migration is intentionally deferred to a separate release step.

production_blockers.description: Publish and independently verify ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_FINGERPRINT and the authorized local ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID.
Choose and publish ZKCOIN_GITIAN_SIGS_REPO_URL and the zkCoin Gitian signer quorum.
Choose and publish ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_REPO_URL for Windows and macOS signing payloads.
Choose and publish ZKCOIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_BASE_URL and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_CHECKSUMS_URL for release artifacts.
Decide whether the first production release keeps litecoin-* binary/artifact names or migrates to zkcoin-* names.
Choose and publish ZKCOIN_MACOS_BUNDLE_ID, macOS signing certificate policy, and notarization ownership.
Choose and publish ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_KEY_CUSTODY and the authorized Windows code-signing key workflow.

current_inherited_release_surfaces.reason: Source archive names still use the temporary Litecoin compatibility namespace.
Automated Gitian helper is inherited from Bitcoin Core and must not be used for zkCoin releases.
Legacy Bitcoin Core verification helper remains guarded for upstream-reference use only; zkCoin verification uses verify-zkcoin-release.py.
Autotools tarname intentionally remains litecoin until binary/artifact migration is decided.
MSVC tarname intentionally remains litecoin until binary/artifact migration is decided.

notes: Do not treat Gitian, signing, notarization, upload, or binary verification instructions as production zkCoin release instructions while status is release_infrastructure_not_ready.
The source release-candidate validation gate proves source tarball real-proof readiness only; it is not binary release readiness and does not authorize publishing artifacts.
Gitian source descriptors fetch zk-coin/zkcoin while retaining the litecoin input directory name until binary and artifact namespace migration is decided.
zkCoin binary artifact verification is parameterized through contrib/verifybinaries/verify-zkcoin-release.py; production signing keys and artifact hosts remain separate release blockers.

Gitian signer descriptors intentionally use an example.invalid detached-signatures URL and release docs require ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_REPO_URL so inherited Litecoin detached signatures cannot be used by default.

Release checksum signing docs require ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_FINGERPRINT and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID before creating SHA256SUMS.asc so a default local GPG key cannot sign zkCoin releases by accident.

Release artifact publication docs require ZKCOIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_BASE_URL, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_CHECKSUMS_URL, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_GITHUB_REPO_URL so inherited Litecoin and Bitcoin publication targets cannot be used by default.
macOS notarization docs require ZKCOIN_MACOS_BUNDLE_ID and zkCoin Apple notarization variables so inherited Litecoin bundle identifiers cannot be used by default.
Windows signing docs require ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_KEY_PATH and ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_KEY_CUSTODY so placeholder signing key paths cannot be used by default.
When a blocker is resolved, update this manifest and the release lint in the same PR.
